artworks.title: Pfalzgraf Friedrich III
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, with face and hands developed in oil (?) on vellum (?) laid on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Adolph Caspar Miller
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an upper-body portrait. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, looking in the same direction. The man has a defined facial structure with a long, narrow nose, a light beard, and mustache. He wears a large, ornate hat with a feather, a high-collared shirt, a detailed coat, and a necklace with a pendant. His right hand is holding part of his clothing near the waist. The background is a dark, solid color.

artworks.title: Maria Markgräfin zu Brandenburg
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, with face and hands developed in oil (?) on vellum (?) laid on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Adolph Caspar Miller
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the waist up. The person is slightly turned sideways but their head is facing the viewer. They have light skin, a straight nose, full lips, and reddish hair tucked neatly under a white cap with decorative trim. The person is wearing a high-necked garment with a dark bodice and light sleeves with lace detailing at the cuffs. Their hands are placed at their midsection. The background is a solid dark color.

artworks.title: The Visit to the Spinner
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.2 x 11.1 cm (6 3/8 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a room. One person is seated on the left, wearing a cloak and a hat with feathers. The other person is seated on the right, spinning yarn. The first person is near a large cupboard with pitchers and jugs. A cat is on the floor. In the background, there is an arc-like structure with vertical columns. The scene suggests a blend of domestic utility and aesthetic embellishment.

artworks.title: The Virgin on the Crescent
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing and holding an infant in her arms. The woman is upright, facing forward, and supporting the child with both hands. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a calm expression, and she wears a crown on her head. She is dressed in long, flowing garments. The infant she holds faces forward and wears a smaller robe. Both figures are surrounded by a radiant halo. The woman wears no visible jewelry, but her crown stands out. The scene is set against a background with lines implying light radiating from the figures.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with the Pear
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image features a woman and a child beneath a large tree. The woman is seated with the child in her lap. She has long hair and a gentle expression, looking down. The child has curly hair and wide eyes, facing the viewer directly. The woman is draped in a flowing garment, with folds visible. They are outdoors, on grass, with a lamb nearby. In the background, there are stone towers, arched bridges, and a cloudy sky. The image is dated "1511".

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts most of the body of two individuals. The first person is seated on a large armchair with ornate, curved armrests, slightly reclined, one arm resting on their head and the other holding a book in their lap. They have wide-open eyes, prominent dark eyebrows, and short, curly dark hair, wearing a long, pink dress with short sleeves. The second individual is a child standing near a doorway, partly obscured by the door. They have blonde hair styled neatly, dressed in a light blue dress, holding a doll in a pink garment, and a folded cloth in their other hand. The floor features a pattern of diamond shapes in green and red, while the wall behind the chair appears light-colored with a subtle texture. The background shows a simple corner of the room and the open door, indicating an indoor domestic setting.

artworks.title: Woman Holding a Rose
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman depicted in profile, facing to the right. She is standing upright with her hair styled in a bun. Her facial features are detailed, and she is wearing a dark blue gown with puffed sleeves. She is holding a small flower and wearing a gold hoop earring, a necklace, and a lace-like collar. The background features a textured oval frame with floral motifs in red, yellow, and green, on a parchment-like background. The initials "C. H." and the date "1809" are written in gold lettering at the bottom of the frame. Surrounding the portrait are colorful, stylized flowers and leaves.

artworks.title: Samuel C. Stevens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait from the chest up of a man named Samuel C. Stevens. The man is depicted in a left-facing position, showing his side profile. He has a prominent hairstyle with his dark hair combed upwards and back. His facial features include a straight nose, a slightly curved lip, and a prominent jawline. He is wearing a high collared shirt, a decorative cravat or neckcloth, a patterned waistcoat, and a dark jacket. The background is plain and neutral. There are no visible jewelry or accessories. The focus seems to be on the artistry and style of the portrayed subject.

artworks.title: Bear in Tree
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 22.3 x 37 cm (8 3/4 x 14 9/16 in.)
support: 22.7 x 37.2 cm (8 15/16 x 14 5/8 in.)
framed: 27.3 x 41.9 cm (10 3/4 x 16 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of wildlife in a forest setting. The scene depicts a bear in a tree, a deer walking, and a striped feline on the ground. The background features trees with round foliage on a textured backdrop, with sections of grass. The colors contrast with the greenery, and there is a sense of movement through the flowing form of the tree branches and leaves. This is in the style of folk or naive art, characterized by its simplified shapes and bold use of color.

artworks.title: In Memoriam - Column at Left
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper mounted on wood
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in dark robes surrounding a large obelisk with flowers. One figure stands out in a white gown. Lush vegetation surrounds them, including tall trees and a weeping willow. In the background, an ancient column and a bridge over water lead to a distant townscape. The sky is cloudy with earthy tones, and the colors are soft and muted.

artworks.title: Dancing Children
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing in full length. The figure on the left has long, curly brown hair and is dressed in a light dress with blue accents. This person is raising both arms as if holding a garland. To the right stands a child with long hair and a similar dress with blue stripes. The child has one hand raised. In the foreground, there is a tree and flowering plants on green, hilly terrain. The background shows a plain, light-colored sky.

artworks.title: Mother and Daughter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of two women in a partial body frame. The woman on the left is seated on a simple wooden chair with a high back. She has a balanced posture with her face turned towards the other woman. Her facial features are calmly depicted with fine lines, a pointed nose, and a defined chin. Her hair is styled in a classic bun at the back of her head with a few strands draping onto her upper back. She is wearing a brown dress with puffed sleeves. The other woman is standing slightly turned towards the seated figure, bending forward slightly. Her facial features are similarly stylized, and she is wearing a bonnet that covers most of her hair. Her attire is a long pink dress with a broad collar. The seated woman holds a small pair of scissors in one hand. The background features rich green drapery and the floor is decorated with a geometric pattern in muted tones of blue and white.

artworks.title: Mother and Three Children Making a Floral Wreath
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on paperr mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint of a landscape with colorful houses, trees, and figures. The scene is depicted in a simplistic style with flat colors and defined brushstrokes typical of folk art. The color palette includes earthy greens for the hills and pastel colors for the houses against a deep blue sky. In the foreground, there are two women seated by a waterway, another woman holding a flowering branch, and a child beside her. Trees in the upper right corner frame the scene.

artworks.title: Woman and Boy with Provisions
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman and a young boy standing outdoors. The woman stands on the left, holding a basket on a table and an animal. She wears a straw hat, long-sleeved dress, and an apron. The boy stands on the right, holding a hat. They are surrounded by a house, trees, a wooden fence, and chickens in a grassy field.

artworks.title: Baby with Locket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young child seated and facing forward. The child has soft facial features, fair skin, rosy cheeks, light blue eyes, and is wearing a white dress with blue ribbon accents. They wear a white bonnet with lace. The child is holding cherries and a rattle-like toy. They wear a coral bead necklace with a pendant displaying the number "118." The background is a muted blue-gray color.

artworks.title: Baby in Pink Dress with Roses
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing. They have blue eyes, finely spaced eyebrows, and blonde hair styled close to the head. The person is wearing a light pink dress with a ruffled collar, puffed short sleeves, red scalloped trim at the hem and sleeves, and matching pantaloons with red trim. They have vibrant yellow shoes with floral designs and are holding a bouquet of colorful flowers with their right hand. The background is black.

artworks.title: Woman with Plumed Hat
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is facing forward, holding a large hat on her head. She has curly, dark hair with ringlets at the sides of her face and delicate facial features. She is wearing a long, brown high-waisted dress with long sleeves and intricate fabric work towards the hem. Over her shoulders, she wears a white lace shawl that drapes down. She carries a small, round handbag with blue and white stripes. The background features green bushes or small trees to the right and a slightly clouded blue sky.

artworks.title: The Beautiful Virgin of Regensburg Seated in a Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image features two figures seen from head to toe. The larger figure is seated and appears to be holding the smaller figure on their lap. The seated figure has their head slightly tilted towards the child and is wearing a robe with intricate patterns and a headscarf. The child has curly hair and is dressed in a simple, flowing garment, holding a long object. Both figures have radiant halos around their heads. In the background, there is a depiction of a natural scene with trees and possibly a building or structure faintly visible to the right. The entire scene is rendered in a monochromatic, etched style, with lines creating shading and texture.

artworks.title: Mississippi Bear
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear on a rocky ledge in a forested landscape. The bear, depicted in profile, stands on a rocky outcrop that overlooks a deep gorge or valley. The fur of the bear is textured and detailed, surrounded by lush trees with intricate leaves. The scene conveys the wild and rugged nature of the bear's environment, with bushes and small plants dotting the ground. The drawing is monochromatic, but the shading and line work create a vivid image of the bear in its natural habitat.

artworks.title: Anne 1921
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a portrait sketch of a young girl from 1921. The drawing shows her head and shoulders. She is facing directly forward with a direct gaze. Her features include large eyes, a small nose, and a slightly pouty mouth. The girl has long, dark, wavy hair with straight bangs. She wears a garment with a high rounded collar. The sketch is primarily in grayscale using various shading techniques. The background is plain with no additional elements. At the bottom, there is handwriting that includes the name 'Anna,' the year '1921,' and a signature by the artist.

artworks.title: Woman Having Supper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dining scene with a focus on a table setting. The scene depicts an elegantly dressed person seated at a dining table, with a pitcher being poured into a glass by another figure. The table is adorned with plates of food, including fruits and a dish to the side. The setting suggests a fine dining experience, emphasized by the detailed tableware and the attire of those present. The artwork employs muted tones and a delicate interplay of lines to convey a sense of elegance and leisure. This is in the style of early 20th-century European painting.

artworks.title: The Sagot Address
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in an art gallery. Two women are featured prominently, one wearing a black dress with a hat adorned with a feather, and the other in a green dress with a hat decorated with flowers. They are looking at displayed art or illustrations. Other individuals are also present, observing the artworks. The background shows an art shop with a sign reading "ED. SAGOT" above an awning with yellow and orange stripes. The setting is colored in warm hues.

artworks.title: Willows and White Poplars (Saules et peupliers blancs)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a landscape with trees dominating the scene. The viewpoint is from one side of a path or open area, with trees placed across the composition. Close to the viewer, tall trees with dense foliage are sketched using short, textured strokes. To the right, a few slender trees with bare branches stretch upward. The horizon is low with minimal detail suggesting distant land forms or rocks. The sketch is monochrome with various shades of gray, creating a calm atmosphere. The style is loose yet precise, capturing the natural essence of the landscape.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman holding a child at the base of a tree, with an elderly figure beside them. Numerous cherubic figures are around them, some holding hands and others on tree branches. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with buildings on rocky outcrops.
